$comment: Ethereum-leg asset registry. Consumed by scripts today and by the frontend swap card later. Addresses are verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) before entering this file; the test gate validates the shape. Quirk flags tell clients how to drive each token: approvalRace = allowance must be reset to 0 before it can be changed (USDT); noReturnValue = approve/transfer/transferFrom return no data (USDT); issuerBlocklist = the issuer can block addresses, see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md stablecoin section for how that interacts with claim/refund; feeOnTransferSwitch = the token ships a currently-dormant transfer fee mechanism (the HTLC rejects the lock if it ever activates). minLockAmount is the dust floor in token units for order-book spam resistance.
